components.name: Native dialog visual foundation
components.description: Visual specimen. Production uses native dialog.showModal(); close stays outside the scrolling wrapper.
components.html:
Make a little room for us.

Choose a celebration, then your calendar.

Calendar entries use a 1-hour reminder block. Event finish times are unannounced; adjust the duration when saving.
components.css: .ds-dialog{position:relative;width:calc(100% - 32px);max-width:620px;border:1px solid #bc9450;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper,#faf1df);color:var(--ink,#492b24);box-shadow:0 25px 80px #0005;font-family:var(--body,"Manrope",Arial,sans-serif);} .ds-dialog-scroll{padding:42px;overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100svh - 52px);overscroll-behavior:contain;} .ds-dialog h2{margin:0;padding-right:15px;font:500 42px/1.15 var(--display,"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif);letter-spacing:-.02em;} .ds-dialog p{margin:13px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#745c4b);font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;} .ds-dialog small{display:block;margin-top:18px;color:var(--muted,#745c4b);font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;} .ds-close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:none;color:var(--wine,#300e17);cursor:pointer;} .ds-close:hover{background:var(--sand,#edddbf);} .ds-close:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px;} .ds-close svg{width:21px;height:21px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.4;stroke-linecap:round;} @media(max-width:700px){.ds-dialog-scroll{padding:38px 24px 26px;max-height:calc(100svh - 32px);}.ds-dialog h2{font-size:35px;}.ds-close{top:6px;right:6px;}}

components.name: Calendar event choice
components.description: Pressed-state styling for wedding/reception choice; production updates provider links with selection.
components.css: .ds-choices{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:24px;background:var(--paper,#faf1df);font-family:var(--body,"Manrope",Arial,sans-serif);} .ds-choices button{flex:1;min-height:80px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--rule,#b18a4e55);border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#492b24);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;} .ds-choices button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--wine,#300e17);color:var(--paper,#faf1df);border-color:var(--wine,#300e17);} .ds-choices button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px;} .ds-choices span{display:block;font:400 24px/1.3 var(--display,"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif);} .ds-choices small{display:block;margin-top:8px;font:400 11px/1.8 var(--body,"Manrope",Arial,sans-serif);} @media(max-width:700px){.ds-choices{gap:8px;}.ds-choices button{padding:11px 10px;}.ds-choices span{font-size:22px;}}

narrative.overview:
A richly decorated mandap opens the wedding celebration with Lord Ganapathi, a Kannada invocation and the couple's names. Deep wine, vermilion, antique gold, flower garlands and sandalwood paper create the divine atmosphere explicitly requested on 1 November 2026. This replaces the earlier blue minimal direction.

Scene-setting raster artwork carries the ornament; clear typography and open schedules carry the information. Ganapathi remains the first focal point. The final code-led implementation, with `style.css` followed by `divine.css`, is the visual authority; no approved external comp exists. `DESIGN-BRIEF.md` holds the surface contract and `PRODUCT.md` holds corrected names and event facts.
keyCharacteristics: Ganapathi first, framed by a full-bleed illuminated mandap.
Deep wine and antique gold contrasted with warm reading paper.
Independently composed portrait artwork for phones.
Bilingual type with generous Kannada line spacing.
Purposeful dialogs, user-controlled sound and motion, and readable static defaults.

rules.name: The Lamp-and-Paper Rule
rules.body: Pair light gold or paper with wine; pair ink or muted ink with paper. Let artwork and brass details enrich dark surfaces while keeping event copy clear.

rules.name: The Two-Script Rule
rules.body: Kannada uses its own family, zero display tracking and longer line heights. Preserve its language-specific metrics rather than shrinking it into English measurements.

rules.name: The Controlled Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Twelve tiny CSS motes replace a continuous full-screen canvas. They pause offscreen, in hidden tabs and while dialogs are open; motion controls and reduced-motion preferences are respected. Sound starts only after an explicit sound-control action.

dos: Do place Ganapathi before the names and preserve the divine mandap atmosphere.
Do use wine, vermilion, gold and warm paper through the semantic tokens.
Do retain independent mobile artwork and Kannada typography.
Do keep dialog close controls reachable and preserve focus, scrolling and reduced-motion behavior.
Do preserve Shridhar, Bhat / ಭಟ್, the supplied home pin and honestly labeled calendar holds from product truth.
donts: Don't restore the retired blue minimal identity or use layout aliases as new palette names.
Don't represent generated scene art as a real venue or fabricate couple portraits.
Don't autoplay sound, run atmosphere behind dialogs or force motion under reduced motion.
Don't imply that local petal animations submit, store or deliver blessings.
